issues.description: Parser state advancement uses 'substring' to create a new string copy on every character consumed. This results in O(N^2) time and space complexity relative to the input length N, as the entire remaining string is copied for each character.
issues.suggested_fix: Store the original input string and an integer offset in the State object. Access characters using 'string-ref' at the offset and increment the offset instead of slicing the string.

issues.description: The expansion of improper lists in 'qq-expand-list' relies on 'cons*', which is not defined in the project's 'prelude.ss' or within the module itself. This will cause a runtime 'unbound variable' error when expanding quasiquotes with dotted tail structure.
issues.suggested_fix: Define 'cons*' in 'core/base/prelude.ss' or rewrite 'qq-expand-list' to use nested 'cons' calls for the improper tail.

issues.description: The ellipsis pattern matching implementation is incomplete. 'merge-ellipsis-bindings' only supports simple symbol pattern variables and does not correctly extract or merge bindings for complex patterns like '((k . v) ...)'.
issues.code_snippet: ;; For complex patterns, would need to extract and merge
issues.suggested_fix: Implement recursive binding extraction for ellipsis patterns. This should iterate through 'matches' and 'pattern' simultaneously to collect lists of values for each pattern variable.

issues.description: 'string-replace' performs string slicing using 'substring' inside a loop. This leads to O(N^2) time complexity relative to the number of replacements and string length.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify 'string-index-of' to accept an optional starting offset, and use this offset in 'string-replace' to avoid repeated string copying.

issues.description: 'run-reader' is not composable with other effects. Unlike 'run-state' or 'run-writer', it throws an error on unhandled effects instead of re-emitting them using 'make-eff-op'.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the error call with a 'make-eff-op' call that passes the unknown effect to the outer handler, maintaining consistency with other handlers in the module.

issues.description: 'run-nondet-bounded-acc' calls 'length' on the accumulator in every iteration of the choice loop. Since 'length' is O(N), this results in quadratic O(N^2) complexity for result collection.
issues.suggested_fix: Pass an explicit count of current results through the accumulator-based helper or use a more efficient way to track the number of added items.
